decision.nextAction: The installed CLI fetchTemplate function path is verified with one benign loopback ZIP, but full interactive taro init, remote GitHub access, and malicious archive behavior remain untested. Assess the scoped developer-time security risk and whether the future project setup can use the Gitee git-clone route; do not copy the test-only adapter into the formal dependency graph. Full/production audit, malicious-archive security evidence, third-party declaration diagnostics, and formal product module reachability remain open.
